measurement_note: Size is N, the array length. Every value is 2 and k=1, so the rolling DP combines all paths with the same signed exponent while exact cancellation remains necessary. The accepted state method uses O(N) states per prefix on this workload; the correct slower meet-in-the-middle control still enumerates 3^(N/2) assignments per half.
